title: 자기소개하기
description: 이름, 사는 곳, 하는 일 말하기

expressions.en: Nice to meet you.
expressions.tip: 처음 만난 사람에게 하는 인사예요. 대답은 Nice to meet you, too.

expressions.en: Please call me Minji.
expressions.tip: 외국인이 부르기 쉬운 이름을 알려 줄 때 써요.

expressions.en: I'm from Seoul, Korea.
I work at a design company.
expressions.tip: 직업은 I work at ~ 또는 I'm a ~로 말해요.

expressions.en: In my free time, I like to watch movies.
expressions.ko: 시간이 날 때는 영화 보는 걸 좋아해요.

expressions.en: What about you?
expressions.tip: 받은 질문을 되돌려 대화를 이어 가는 만능 표현이에요.

dialogue.setting: 어학원 첫 수업에서 옆자리 사람과 인사해요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi! I'm Alex. I'm new here.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요! 저는 알렉스예요. 여기 처음 왔어요.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Hi, Alex. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Nice to meet you, too. Where are you from?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'm from Seoul, Korea. What about you?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'm from Canada. What do you do?
lines.ko: 저는 캐나다에서 왔어요. 무슨 일 하세요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I work at a design company.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Cool! What do you like to do for fun?
lines.ko: 멋지네요! 재미로 뭐 하는 걸 좋아해요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: In my free time, I like to watch movies.
lines.ko: 시간이 날 때는 영화 보는 걸 좋아해요.

aiScenario.role: a friendly classmate at an English academy
aiScenario.situation: You are meeting the learner for the first time on the first day of class. Ask about their name, where they live, their job, and their hobbies, and share a little about yourself.
aiScenario.opening: Hi there! I'm Alex. Is this your first class here too?
aiScenario.openingKo: 안녕하세요! 저는 알렉스예요. 당신도 여기 첫 수업이에요?

expressions.en: Long time no see!
expressions.tip: 오랜만에 만난 사람에게 반갑게 하는 말이에요.

expressions.en: How have you been?
expressions.tip: 오랜만에 만났을 때는 How are you?보다 자연스러워요.

expressions.en: I've been really busy with work.
Not much. Same as usual.
expressions.tip: What's new? 같은 질문에 하는 대답이에요.

expressions.en: I just started a new job.
Let's catch up over coffee sometime.
expressions.ko: 언제 커피 마시면서 밀린 얘기 해요.
expressions.tip: catch up은 밀린 이야기를 나눈다는 뜻이에요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Oh my gosh, is that you? Long time no see!

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Long time no see! How have you been?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Pretty good. I moved to a new apartment. How about you?
lines.ko: 꽤 잘 지냈어. 새 아파트로 이사했어. 너는?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I've been really busy with work. I just started a new job.
lines.ko: 일 때문에 정말 바빴어. 얼마 전에 새 일을 시작했거든.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Wow, congratulations! Do you like it so far?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, I like it a lot. Let's catch up over coffee sometime.
lines.ko: 응, 정말 좋아. 언제 커피 마시면서 밀린 얘기 하자.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'd love that. I'll text you this week.

aiScenario.role: an old friend the learner hasn't seen for a long time
aiScenario.situation: You run into the learner on the street after a long time. Catch up on work, home, and recent news, and suggest meeting again.
aiScenario.opening: No way, is that you? Long time no see! How have you been?
aiScenario.openingKo: 말도 안 돼, 너야? 진짜 오랜만이다! 그동안 어떻게 지냈어?

expressions.en: What do you do in your free time?
expressions.tip: 취미를 물을 때 What's your hobby?보다 자연스러워요.

expressions.en: I'm really into hiking these days.
I go to the gym three times a week.
I've been learning to play the guitar.
It helps me relieve stress.
You should try it sometime.

dialogue.setting: 회사 동료와 점심을 먹으며 취미 이야기를 해요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: So, what do you do in your free time?
lines.ko: 그래서, 시간 날 때 뭐 해요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'm really into hiking these days.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Nice! How often do you go?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Almost every weekend. It helps me relieve stress.
lines.ko: 거의 주말마다요. 스트레스를 푸는 데 도움이 돼요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I've always wanted to try hiking, but I'm not very fit.
lines.ko: 저도 등산 늘 해 보고 싶었는데, 체력이 별로 안 좋아서요.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: There are some easy trails, too. You should try it sometime.
lines.ko: 쉬운 코스도 있어요. 언제 한번 해 봐요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Maybe I'll join you next time!

aiScenario.role: a coworker having lunch with the learner
aiScenario.situation: You chat about hobbies and free time. Ask what the learner enjoys, how often they do it, and why they like it. Share one hobby of your own.
aiScenario.opening: So, do you have any plans after work today? What do you usually do in your free time?
aiScenario.openingKo: 오늘 퇴근하고 계획 있어요? 시간 날 때 보통 뭐 해요?

expressions.en: Do you have any plans this weekend?
I'm thinking of going to the beach.
expressions.tip: I'm thinking of ~ing는 아직 확정하지 않은 계획에 써요.

expressions.en: Nothing special. I'll just stay home.
expressions.ko: 특별한 건 없어요. 그냥 집에 있을 거예요.

expressions.en: Do you want to come with me?
That sounds great!
What time should we meet?

dialogue.setting: 금요일 퇴근길에 친구와 주말 계획을 이야기해요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Finally, it's Friday! Do you have any plans this weekend?
lines.ko: 드디어 금요일이다! 이번 주말에 무슨 계획 있어?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I'm thinking of going to the beach. Do you want to come with me?
lines.ko: 바다에 갈까 생각 중이야. 나랑 같이 갈래?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: That sounds fun! Saturday or Sunday?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Saturday would be better for me.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Okay, Saturday works for me too.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Great! What time should we meet?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: How about nine in the morning at the station?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: That sounds great! See you then.

aiScenario.situation: It's Friday evening. Ask about the learner's weekend plans, suggest doing something together, and agree on a day, time, and place.
aiScenario.opening: Finally, it's Friday! Do you have anything fun planned for the weekend?
aiScenario.openingKo: 드디어 금요일이다! 주말에 재밌는 계획 있어?

expressions.en: What kind of food do you like?
I love spicy food.
I'm not a big fan of sweets.
expressions.tip: I'm not a big fan of ~는 싫다는 말을 부드럽게 하는 표현이에요.

expressions.en: I can't eat seafood. I'm allergic.
This place is famous for its noodles.
You have to try this!

dialogue.setting: 외국인 친구와 저녁 먹을 식당을 고르고 있어요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: I'm starving. What kind of food do you like?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: I love spicy food. How about you?
lines.ko: 저는 매운 음식을 정말 좋아해요. 당신은요?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Spicy is okay, but I can't eat seafood. I'm allergic.
lines.ko: 매운 건 괜찮은데, 해산물은 못 먹어요. 알레르기가 있거든요.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: No problem. This place is famous for its noodles.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Great. Do they have anything sweet for dessert?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Maybe, but I'm not a big fan of sweets.
lines.ko: 아마도요, 근데 저는 단 건 별로 안 좋아해요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Ha ha, more for me then!

aiScenario.role: a friend from abroad who is visiting Korea
aiScenario.situation: You are choosing a place for dinner together. Talk about favorite foods and things you can't eat, then decide what to eat.
aiScenario.opening: I'm so hungry! What kind of food do you feel like tonight?
aiScenario.openingKo: 너무 배고파요! 오늘 밤엔 어떤 음식이 당겨요?

expressions.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the subway station?
expressions.tip: 모르는 사람에게 말을 걸 때는 Excuse me로 시작해요.

expressions.en: Is it within walking distance?
Go straight and turn left at the corner.
It's next to the bank.
How long does it take on foot?
Thank you so much for your help.

dialogue.setting: 처음 온 동네에서 지나가는 사람에게 길을 물어요.

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Hi there. You look a little lost. Can I help you?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 길을 잃으신 것 같네요. 도와드릴까요?

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Yes, please. Excuse me, how do I get to the subway station?
lines.ko: 네, 부탁해요. 실례지만, 지하철역에 어떻게 가요?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Go straight and turn left at the corner. It's next to the bank.
lines.ko: 쭉 가다가 모퉁이에서 왼쪽으로 도세요. 은행 옆에 있어요.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Is it within walking distance?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: Yes, it's pretty close.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: How long does it take on foot?

lines.speaker: ai
lines.en: About five minutes.

lines.speaker: user
lines.en: Thank you so much for your help.

aiScenario.role: a friendly local person on the street
aiScenario.situation: The learner is lost and asks you for directions to a place nearby. Give simple directions with landmarks and answer follow-up questions.
aiScenario.opening: Hi! You look a little lost. Are you looking for something?
aiScenario.openingKo: 안녕하세요! 길을 잃으신 것 같네요. 뭐 찾으세요?
